gameLoopReview.loopTightness: Strong. The moment-to-moment loop already supports readable movement, weapons, perks, objectives, shops, formations, and replay hooks.
gameLoopReview.progressionCurve: Strong, with the next leverage point being trust-backed mastery: replays must carry enough player-input evidence to become more than a confidence label.
gameLoopReview.sessionEngagement: Strong. DeathScreen, weekly contracts, ghost targets, and replay links all reinforce retry intent, but empty traces weaken the long-term rivalry/replay promise.
gameLoopReview.retentionHooks: Strong. Daily seeds, ghosts, rivalry links, contract progress, and local-first run history exist; the next lift is proving submitted runs through actual command evidence.
gameLoopReview.soulFidelity: Good. This audit preserves the fast parody arcade feel while making the trust layer more honest and deterministic.

items.item: Replay command traces are encoded at submission time but never populated during a run, so trace-backed competitive submissions can still be empty.
items.recipe: Add a tiny bounded command-trace recorder to src/utils/replayCommandTrace.js, wire App.jsx to record shoot, dash, grenade, perk, route, shop, reload, and weapon-switch events at frame buckets, and cover the recorder with unit tests.
items.evidence: src/utils/replayCommandTrace.js exports recordReplayCommandEvent() and directionBucket(); src/App.jsx records shoot, dash, grenade, perk, route, shop, reload, and weapon-swap events into commandTraceRef before encodeReplayCommandTrace(); replayCommandTrace tests cover bounded recording and direction bucketing.

items.item: buildSessionSubmission forwards whatever commandTrace object it receives, even if the digest/count/body relationship is malformed.
items.recipe: Route trace forwarding through isValidReplayCommandTrace(), omit invalid trace payloads before network submission, and add runSubmission regressions for both valid and invalid traces.
items.evidence: src/utils/runSubmission.js forwards trace fields only when isValidReplayCommandTrace() passes; runSubmission tests cover valid trace inclusion, empty trace omission, and malformed trace stripping.

items.item: validate-replay accepts traceDigest and traceLength but cannot verify an optional trace body when a caller supplies one, leaving the smoke path weaker than submit-score.
items.recipe: Teach supabase/functions/validate-replay/index.ts to accept traceBody, enforce body byte/count/digest/action-shape parity with submit-score, and update scripts/replay-trust-smoke.mjs so live validation proves body-backed contracts.
items.evidence: supabase/functions/validate-replay/index.ts accepts optional traceBody and checks byte budget, count, digest, frame, and action shape; scripts/replay-trust-smoke.mjs now sends body-backed valid and malformed trace cases.

validation.fullTests: npm test passed: 360/360 tests across 44 files.
